d326b0861722da47.description: About Stranger Soccer Stranger Soccer is an international brand that simplifies football participation through a mobile application. Players can find games, reserve spots, and play. Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer operates in over 10 cities globally and has facilitated more than 100,000 games. The company is expanding its operations into new cities. Role Overview Stranger Soccer is seeking a License Owner / Operator to establish and manage its operations in Riyadh Province, specifically in Riyadh. This full-time position involves building and growing a local football operation under the Stranger Soccer brand. The role is designed for individuals with an entrepreneurial approach and a passion for football, aiming to develop a local community while leveraging established technology and global expertise. Key Responsibilities Growing the local player community in Riyadh. Securing football venues and establishing local partnerships. Recruiting and managing Official Hosts for games. Leading marketing efforts and community-building initiatives. Ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality game experiences. Required Profile A football enthusiast with strong local market insight. An entrepreneurial individual capable of independent initiative and ownership. A leader with the ability to build relationships and foster community growth. An individual motivated to create a lasting impact within the local community. Operational Support The License Owner / Operator will maintain independence in managing the local operation. Ongoing support, technology, and operational guidance will be provided by Stranger Soccer's headquarters in Singapore.

d3f53f07ac8cdc36.description: About the Role Caliberly® - Recruitment Agency is seeking experienced Driller Diamond / RC Drilling professionals to join mining and exploration drilling operations in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in the Taif Area and Eastern Province, specifically in Taif, and offers a salary of up to SAR 15,000 per month. The position is suited for hands-on drilling professionals with strong technical expertise and a commitment to safety and productivity in challenging field conditions. Key Responsibilities Operate and maintain diamond core or RC drilling rigs safely and efficiently. Execute drilling activities according to project specifications and target depths. Monitor drilling progress, ground conditions, penetration rates, and equipment performance. Ensure proper core recovery or RC sample collection, handling, labelling, and documentation. Identify and troubleshoot drilling challenges, including stuck rods, water loss, and unstable formations. Conduct routine equipment inspections and coordinate maintenance and repairs. Maintain accurate daily drilling logs, shift reports, and operational records. Coordinate with supervisors, field engineers, geologists, and drilling crew members. Comply with all site HSE policies, safety procedures, and PPE requirements. Candidate Requirements 5-10 years of experience in diamond drilling or reverse circulation (RC) drilling operations. Demonstrated operational experience and strong technical expertise in drilling. Ability to work in remote mining locations and adapt to rotational schedules. Strong commitment to safety, teamwork, and operational efficiency. Work Environment This role involves working in remote mining locations within the Taif Area and Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia. Candidates should be prepared for rotational schedules and challenging field conditions, maintaining a focus on safety and productivity.

d3d951c0d9a0160a.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة بدر الحميدي الجديعي العتيبي للصيانه والتشغيل عن ميكانيكي مصاعد للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية فحص وصيانة وتصليح المصاعد والسلالم المتحركة والمقاعد الهوائية والأرصفة المتحركة، مما يضمن سلامتها وكفاءتها التشغيلية. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل تتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء عمليات التفتيش الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية، وتحديد الأضرار التي قد تلحق بالمعدات. تصليح واستبدال الأجزاء التالفة أو المعطوبة، واختبار المعدات بعد إتمام التصليح لضمان عملها الصحيح. تفكيك المعدات لإجراء التحسينات الأساسية وإعادة تجميعها، وتوفير الأجزاء المطلوبة لعمليات الصيانة والتصليح. حفظ السجلات الدقيقة لجميع خدمات المعدات وعمليات التصليح التي تم إجراؤها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة وتصليح المصاعد أو ما شابهها. القدرة على فحص وتشخيص الأعطال في المصاعد والسلالم المتحركة. مهارات جيدة في التصليح الميكانيكي واستبدال الأجزاء. بيئة العمل يعمل ميكانيكي المصاعد ضمن فريق في مدينة الرياض، في وظيفة بدوام كامل. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة لضمان الأداء الأمثل للمعدات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية قوية في الميكانيكا. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بالدقة والجودة في العمل. القدرة على اتباع الإرشادات والتعليمات الفنية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مؤسسة بدر الحميدي الجديعي العتيبي للصيانه والتشغيل، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

d31344b5cf095312.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced IBM Cognos Analytics Developer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise reports, dashboards, and analytics solutions using IBM Cognos Analytics. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in developing complex reports and interactive dashboards based on customer requirements, working with data models and cubes, and integrating Cognos content with IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS) and 3D Dashboard solutions. The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering high-quality business intelligence solutions that enable data-driven decision-making through advanced reporting, analytics, and visualization. Key Responsibilities Gather and analyze business requirements from customers and translate them into reporting and analytics solutions. Design, develop, and maintain complex operational, analytical, and executive reports using IBM Cognos Analytics. Develop interactive dashboards, KPI scorecards, and self-service analytics to meet customer requirements. Design and implement drill-down, drill-through, and parameterized reports. Develop and maintain multidimensional data models, Framework Manager models, and data modules. Design, build, and optimize OLAP cubes and data cubes for high-performance analytics and reporting. Develop advanced calculations, metrics, prompts, filters, and custom expressions. Integrate IBM Cognos Analytics with IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS), enterprise databases, and third-party applications. Support the development and integration of Cognos reports and dashboards with IBM Maximo 3D Dashboard capabilities and visualization solutions. Optimize report performance and troubleshoot complex reporting issues. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and governance across reporting solutions. Develop reusable reporting templates and dashboard components. Collaborate with business users, solution architects, and technical teams throughout the project lifecycle. Prepare technical documentation, user guides, and knowledge transfer materials. Provide production support, enhancements, and performance tuning for Cognos environments. Required Technical Skills IBM Technologies IBM Cognos Analytics IBM Cognos Report Studio / Reporting IBM Cognos Dashboard IBM Framework Manager IBM Cognos Data Modules IBM Cognos Event Studio (preferred) IBM Cognos Administration Reporting & Analytics Complex Report Development Executive Dashboards KPI Dashboards Drill-through Reports Scheduled Reports Bursting Reports Data Visualization Analytical Reporting Data & Database Skills SQL (Advanced) Data Modeling OLAP Cubes Data Cubes Star Schema and Snowflake Schema ETL concepts Performance Tuning Database Experience IBM Db2 Oracle Microsoft SQL Server PostgreSQL Other enterprise relational databases Integration Skills REST APIs JDBC/ODBC IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS) TNCP Performance Dashbaord. 3D Dashboard Integration Enterprise data integration concepts Required Experience 5+ years of hands-on experience with IBM Cognos Analytics. Proven experience developing complex reports and dashboards for enterprise customers. Strong experience with Framework Manager and metadata modeling. Experience designing and maintaining OLAP/data cubes for analytical reporting. Experience integrating Cognos with enterprise applications, including IBM Maximo Application Suite. Strong SQL development and query optimization skills. Experience with performance tuning of reports and dashboards. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable reporting solutions. Preferred Qualifications IBM Cognos Analytics Certification. Experience with IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS). Experience developing dashboards for IBM Maximo Monitor or IBM Maximo Visual Inspection. Knowledge of data warehousing and business intelligence best practices. Experience with OpenShift and cloud-based deployments. Familiarity with Python or scripting for automation is an advantage. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to interact directly with customers and gather reporting requirements. Strong documentation and solution design capabilities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Customer-focused mindset with the ability to deliver high-quality analytics solutions within project timelines. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered. Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in IBM Cognos Analytics, with the ability to develop sophisticated reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions tailored to customer requirements. The candidate should be proficient in building and optimizing data models and cubes, integrating Cognos with IBM Maximo Application Suite and 3D Dashboard environments, and delivering scalable, high-performance business intelligence solutions that support operational and executive decision-making.

d31f4621664e7955.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث Namaa Partners عن محلل أداء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يعمل محلل الأداء بشكل وثيق مع الشركاء لتحليل بيانات العملاء وتحويلها إلى رؤى واضحة تدعم اتخاذ القرار. يشمل الدور التعامل مع مجموعة واسعة من البيانات، بدءًا من قوائم المبيعات وتقارير التشغيل وصولاً إلى نماذج التكاليف والموازنات، بهدف تقديم قراءات وتحليلات يمكن عرضها والدفاع عنها أمام مجالس الإدارة أو الشركاء في المجموعات العائلية. عن Namaa Partners Namaa Partners هي شركة استشارات استراتيجية تركز على العمل مع الجهات والشركات ذات المصالح الكبيرة في المملكة العربية السعودية. تغطي خدمات الشركة مجالات متعددة تشمل استراتيجية الشركات، النمو، دخول الأسواق، تصميم النماذج التشغيلية، كفاءة التشغيل، التنظيم، الموارد البشرية، الاستراتيجية الرقمية، تحسين الأداء، الحوكمة، وإدارة المخاطر. تشمل قاعدة عملائها المجموعات العائلية وشركاتها القابضة، الشركات المدرجة، شركات المحافظ في صناديق الملكية الخاصة، البنوك، شركات التأمين، والجهات الحكومية والمنشآت الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع بيانات العملاء وتنظيمها في ملفات عمل واضحة، مع التحقق من صحة الأرقام ومصادرها قبل استخدامها في أي تحليل. بناء نماذج مالية وتشغيلية بسيطة لمقارنة الأداء بين الفروع أو الوحدات أو السنوات، وتحديد الفجوات المحتملة وأسبابها. إعداد شرائح وعروض تنفيذية تعرض النتائج للشركاء قبل الاجتماعات مع العملاء، وتعديلها بناءً على الملاحظات. حضور بعض اجتماعات الفريق مع العملاء لتدوين الملاحظات والأسئلة التي تتطلب متابعة أو بيانات إضافية. متابعة مؤشرات الأداء بعد بدء التنفيذ وتحديث الملفات بشكل دوري لتوضيح التحسينات والتحديات المستمرة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ودائمة، وتتيح العمل عن بعد مع وجود مقر للشركة في الرياض. ما تقدمه الشركة فرصة عمل دائمة بدوام كامل مع إمكانية العمل عن بعد، ومقر الشركة في الرياض. التعرض المباشر لعملية بناء الاستشارات، من تحديد نطاق العمل الأولي إلى تقديم العروض النهائية أمام مجالس الإدارة. التعامل المباشر مع بيانات وأرقام عملاء من قطاعات متنوعة في المملكة، تشمل مجموعات عائلية، شركات مدرجة، وجهات حكومية. العمل مع الشركاء لفهم كيفية قراءة النموذج التشغيلي قبل صياغة التوصيات. المهارات والكفاءات المطلوبة للنجاح القدرة على العمل بتركيز على البيانات لفترات طويلة قبل الوصول إلى النتائج، مع الاستمتاع بترتيب الأرقام لجعلها مفهومة. مهارات كتابة موجزة وواضحة، مع مراجعة دقيقة للمحتوى قبل الإرسال، والتحقق من مصادر الأرقام بدلاً من الافتراض. المرونة في قبول الملاحظات وتعديل العروض التقديمية بسرعة بعد مراجعة الشركاء. القدرة على إدارة ملفات متعددة في وقت واحد مع تحديد أولويات واضحة لضمان إنجاز العمل بفعالية.

d338884413d103a4.description: About the Role Saudi Airlines is seeking a Manager Payment Development to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves managing the daily operations, delivery, and continuous improvement of digital payment solutions across the Saudia Group. The position requires strong expertise in digital payments, stakeholder management, regulatory compliance, and vendor coordination, with over 10 years of experience required. Role Purpose The Manager Payment Development will oversee payment acquiring activities, digital wallet initiatives, payment gateway integrations, and payment-related projects. The primary objective is to ensure secure, efficient, and customer-centric payment experiences for the Saudia Group. Key Responsibilities Manage the delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of digital payment solutions, including payment gateways, acquiring services, and digital wallets. Oversee payment card acquiring activities and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, PCI-DSS standards, and card scheme regulations (Visa and Mastercard). Lead payment-related projects and system enhancements, ensuring timely delivery, operational stability, and alignment with business objectives. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, banking partners, payment service providers, and vendors to implement and optimize payment solutions. Monitor payment performance, transaction success rates, fraud indicators, and customer experience metrics, identifying opportunities for improvement. Manage payment risks, resolve operational and technical issues, and ensure secure, reliable, and efficient payment processing. Prepare performance reports, business cases, and recommendations to support decision-making and payment strategy execution. Lead and develop a team of payment professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. Evaluate emerging payment technologies, market trends, and digital payment innovations to enhance customer experience and support business growth. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 10 years of experience in digital payments is required. Demonstrated expertise in payment acquiring activities, digital wallet initiatives, and payment gateway integrations. Strong understanding of regulatory compliance, PCI-DSS standards, and card scheme regulations (Visa and Mastercard). Proven ability in stakeholder management and vendor coordination. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a dynamic environment focused on continuous improvement and innovation in digital payment solutions. Application Process Saudi Airlines invites qualified candidates to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d3b155f00a982aa6.description: About the Role PEDOX Automobiles is seeking an Automotive Sales & Business Development Executive to expand its automotive workshop, fleet maintenance, and vehicle repair services across the Eastern Province. This is a full-time, field-based B2B business development role, primarily focused on identifying prospects, developing relationships, and securing new corporate and fleet accounts in Dammam, Al Khobar, and Dhahran. Key Responsibilities Identify and approach fleet operators, rent-a-car companies, contracting companies, logistics companies, and other businesses with vehicle fleets. Generate new business for mechanical repairs, preventive maintenance, diagnostics, tyres, batteries, spare parts, and other automotive services. Develop annual maintenance contracts, periodic maintenance agreements, and fleet service arrangements. Conduct regular customer and prospect visits across Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, and surrounding areas. Build and maintain relationships with fleet managers, procurement teams, operations managers, and key decision-makers. Prepare and follow up on quotations, commercial proposals, service agreements, and customer enquiries until conversion. Maintain an active sales pipeline, customer database, lead status, quotation follow-up, and sales activity records. Utilize CRM and ERP systems for recording leads, customer information, quotations, sales activities, job status, and follow-ups. Coordinate with workshop, spare parts, procurement, and accounts teams for vehicle inspection, costing, quotation preparation, job execution, invoicing, and customer delivery. Follow up on completed jobs, customer satisfaction, outstanding quotations, invoices, and payment collections. Develop repeat business and long-term relationships with existing customers. Monitor competitor activities, market opportunities, and customer requirements. Achieve agreed monthly sales, revenue, new-customer, and business-development targets. Submit regular sales pipeline, customer visit, quotation status, conversion, and performance reports to PEDOX Management. Candidate Requirements Currently residing and legally available for employment in Saudi Arabia. Ability to join immediately or within a short notice period. Minimum of 2–5 years of relevant B2B sales/business development experience; automotive industry experience is strongly preferred. Experience in automotive workshops, fleet maintenance, vehicle servicing, spare parts, rent-a-car, or related automotive services is a significant advantage. Good understanding of vehicle maintenance, workshop operations, mechanical repairs, spare parts, and fleet service requirements. Proven ability to generate leads, conduct field visits, negotiate, prepare proposals, follow up, and close business. Experience using CRM software and ERP systems for lead management, quotations, customer records, sales tracking, and reporting. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook/email, and digital reporting tools. Valid Saudi driving licence. Good English communication skills; Arabic is a strong advantage. Existing business contacts with fleet operators, rental companies, contractors, logistics companies, or corporate customers in the Eastern Province will be highly valued. Self-motivated, target-oriented, organized, and capable of working independently in the field. Compensation This role offers a competitive salary complemented by performance-based incentives and commission. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia, covering the cities of Dammam, Al Khobar, and Dhahran. The role requires significant field-based activity and independent work.

d3fcc184925d58e5.description: About the Role LanceSoft Middle East is seeking a Field Specialist II – Tubular Services (TBL) (Field Supervisor TRS) for a 1-year contract position. This role is based in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, specifically in the Dhahran/Dammam area, and operates on a 60 days on / 30 days off rotation. This opportunity is open to Saudi Nationals currently residing in Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities Supervising field crews and coordinating operations with the Company. Performing rig-up and rig-down procedures for tubular services equipment. Monitoring torque-turn operations during casing and tubing running. Conducting equipment maintenance and troubleshooting as required. Ensuring strong HSE leadership, conducting risk assessments, and maintaining compliance with safety procedures. Managing high-risk rig-floor operations and handling heavy tubular equipment. Qualifications and Experience 5–10 years of hands-on oilfield experience in Tubular Running Services (TRS). 6–8+ years of active field experience on onshore or offshore drilling rigs. Proven experience in casing and tubing running operations. Proficiency in hydraulic power tongs, CRTi tools, and casing drive systems (CDS). Relevant field safety and operational certifications. Required Skills Ability to supervise field crews effectively. Strong understanding of HSE principles and risk assessment. Proficiency in equipment maintenance and troubleshooting. Capability to handle high-risk operations and heavy equipment. Work Environment This is a contract position with a rotation schedule of 60 days on and 30 days off. The role requires being based in Saudi Arabia, specifically in the Dhahran/Dammam area, and involves working in oilfield environments, including onshore or offshore drilling rigs. Application Information Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this Field Specialist II position in Tubular Services.

d3b749fca34df7a8.job_title: Step Up Your Pastry Career: Junior Pastry Sous Chef - Al Khobar
d3b749fca34df7a8.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Back of House (Reporting to the Head Chef / Head Pastry Chef) Compensation: 7,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are exclusively partnering with an exquisite, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this upscale kitchen is looking for a driven pastry professional to bring quiet excellence and creativity to their pastry section. The Role As a Junior Pastry Sous Chef, you will support the Head Pastry Chef in managing the pastry section. You will take ownership of daily production—ranging from delicate viennoiserie to refined plated desserts—while maintaining uncompromising quality, developing the junior team, and confidently stepping up to lead the section when needed. Your Profile & Experience Experience: 3 to 5 years of dedicated pastry experience, with at least 2 to 3 years serving as a Chef de Partie Pastry or senior pastry cook within a fine dining or upscale restaurant setting. Technical Foundation: Deep, hands-on knowledge of viennoiserie, doughs, creams, chocolate work, and fillings, alongside a strict understanding of shelf life, storage protocols, and allergen controls. Traits: Precise, creative, and quietly excellent. You are cost-aware and focused on consistency. Language: English fluency is mandatory. Additional skills in French or another European language are highly advantageous. Core Responsibilities Pastry Techniques: Execute classic and contemporary pastry techniques with precision, care, and a highly refined eye for presentation. Leadership & Mentoring: Actively participate in motivating and developing the pastry team, maintain discipline during busy services, and lead the section with confidence in the Head Pastry Chef's absence. Production & Storage: Plan daily production, rigorously monitor shelf life, maintain strict FIFO and labeling standards, and flawlessly execute freezing and defrosting procedures. Hygiene & Quality: Ensure every item leaving the section meets strict standards for taste, texture, and visual appeal while keeping the workspace clean, safe, and fully compliant. Cost & Inventory Control: Monitor stock levels, manage portion controls, and minimize waste, ensuring premium quality is maintained without losing sight of food costs.

d30326f91a8f9610.description: Your mission: The Consumer & Channel Sales Manager provides operational management of the Consumer Sales team in Saudi Arabia. They will be responsible for the achievement of quantitative and qualitative objectives of the team and provide specialist knowledge to both the sales team and KSA customers. What you will do: Sales strategy and business growth Develop and execute the annual consumer sales strategy in line with Saudi Arabia's business plan and regional objectives. Achieve annual, quarterly, and monthly sales targets, including revenue, volume, and profitability. Identify opportunities to grow the consumer printing business, particularly EcoTank and other home and small-office printing solutions. Develop growth plans by channel, customer, product category, and geographical region. Monitor market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and consumer demand to identify new opportunities. Channel and distribution management Develop and manage relationships with distributors, master resellers, T2 partners, retail chains, and independent retailers. Expand the active partner base and improve productivity among existing partners. Identify new partners and reduce overdependence on a limited number of distributors or customers. Establish clear sales targets, account plans, joint business plans (JBPs), and performance reviews for key partners. Ensure healthy channel inventory, appropriate stock availability, and sustainable partner profitability. Monitor partner performance and implement corrective actions where targets are not being achieved. Retail execution and sell-out development Drive consumer sell-out across key retail accounts and independent retail channels. Develop retail activation plans, promotional campaigns, product displays, and in-store visibility. Ensure effective product positioning, pricing compliance, merchandising, and availability across priority outlets. Work with retail account managers, promoters, and merchandisers to improve conversion and product recommendation. Conduct regular market visits across Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and other priority cities. Track retail inventory and ageing to minimize excess stock, stock-outs, and channel loading. E-commerce and omnichannel development Develop consumer sales through online retailers, marketplaces, and distributors' e-commerce platforms. Work closely with the online sales and marketing teams to improve product visibility, assortment, conversion, and promotional execution. Ensure accurate product listings, competitive pricing, and availability across online channels. Identify opportunities to expand Epson's consumer portfolio and increase online revenue contribution. Forecasting, reporting, and commercial discipline Prepare accurate sales forecasts and maintain regular visibility of sell-in, sell-out, inventory, and pipeline performance. Review performance against the agreed business forecast, identifying risks and recovery actions early. Maintain accurate sales reporting and partner information in the designated CRM or sales management system. Monitor sales by customer, product, channel, and region to identify growth opportunities and underperformance. Manage commercial investments, rebates, promotional budgets, and partner incentives in line with agreed policies. Ensure sales growth is achieved without compromising margin, channel health, or commercial compliance. Cross-functional collaboration Work closely with marketing to develop consumer campaigns, product launches, and retail activation programs. Coordinate with supply chain and distribution teams to secure stock availability and prioritize high-demand products. Collaborate with business units on product strategy, pricing, promotions, and new product introductions. Share market intelligence and competitor insights with regional management. Align with service and technical teams to ensure appropriate consumer support and customer satisfaction. Leadership and capability development Lead, coach, and develop the consumer sales team and relevant field resources. Set clear individual objectives, KPIs, and performance expectations. Develop the capabilities of channel account managers and retail-facing teams through structured coaching and training. Promote accountability, ownership, disciplined execution, and cross-functional teamwork. What we ask for: Experience of, or acceptance of working in a matrix organisation and use of centrally resourced functions. 2-3 years+ experience in a sales leadership or team management role. Strong knowledge of the Saudi consumer electronics and/or IT hardware landscape. Experience working for a multinational organisation is preferred. Strong commercial negotiation, account management, and business planning capabilities A track record of sales results demonstrating customer portfolio growth. Good record of academic achievement. Fluent in Arabic and professional level spoken and written English skills. What we offer: Our benefits In return, we offer a competitive salary and a wide range of excellent benefits, including a working environment where quality, teamwork, and respect come first. Our heritage We aspire to be an indispensable company, trusted throughout the world for our commitment to openness, customer satisfaction and sustainability. We respect individuality while promoting teamwork, and we are committed to delivering unique value through innovative and creative solutions. Our commitment to the environment We all have a role to play in building a better future. For Epson, being a sustainable company means being mindful of every aspect of our organisation – from the smallest lightbulb to the largest factory. It fuels our innovation, drives our growth, motivates our workforce and, ultimately, to contribute to society. Our people We believe a healthy culture, strong values, teamwork and contribution from a diverse range of individuals will help us to strive for excellence. Our brand Ranked by Clarivate Analytics as a Top 100 Global Innovator brand for the last seven years running.

d3651e2e682bd7f1.description: Job description At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Marketing & Omnichannel Enabler - Multiple Sclerosis for the Middle East is responsible for shaping and executing customer- and patient-centric commercial strategies, including marketing, brand, and customer engagement, for the assigned disease area across the Middle East. This role connects brand ambition with customer experience - integrating market insights, omnichannel engagement, and product strategies to deliver impactful, insights-driven, and patient-centered outcomes. This role operates 80% for the ME countries, working closely with Disease Area Squads, ME affiliate POCs, Disease Commercialization Leader (DCL), Patient Journey Partners (PJPs), Medical, Access, and Informatics to co-create meaningful experiences and drive commercial success. The remaining 20% will stay within the local Affiliate or Chapter to maintain flexibility and relevance at the local level. d36c50bbb364ef0d.description: About the Role Ma’aden is seeking a Principal Specialist, Data Modeling & Arch Enterprise . This full-time role involves leading the design, modeling, and evolution of enterprise data architecture. The objective is to ensure that data products, curated layers, and integration patterns are standardized, scalable, high-quality, and governed across the organization. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with enterprise business domains and data architecture principles. Define canonical models, conformed dimensions, master/reference data structures, and reusable modeling patterns for cross-domain consistency. Design data product models and curated layer schemas that support enterprise reporting, analytics, AI use cases, and downstream integrations. Ensure models address performance, maintainability, scalability, auditability, lineage, and future reuse across platforms and domains. Establish enterprise modeling standards, naming conventions, guidelines, reusable templates, and quality expectations for delivery teams. Partner with data governance teams to align business glossary definitions, stewardship ownership, metadata, lineage, and critical data elements. Embed governance-by-design into data models, curated layers, transformation logic, data quality controls, and consumption patterns. Review and approve modeling deliverables from internal teams and external vendors to ensure architectural consistency and quality. Lead the creation and optimization of data product schemas, curated layers, semantic structures, and consumption-ready models. Define modeling approaches for relational, non-relational, time-series, streaming, lakehouse, warehouse, and analytical platform requirements. Ensure data models support time-variant structures, historical traceability, auditability, semantic consistency, and trusted analytics consumption. Coordinate with data engineering, platform, analytics, AI, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure models are technically feasible and reusable. Define integration patterns that ensure consistent transformation logic, metadata, lineage, and data quality across source-to-consumption pipelines. Align operational, corporate, and analytical data structures to enable reliable reporting, analytics, AI enablement, and downstream system integration. Identify and resolve modeling inconsistencies, duplication, semantic gaps, and integration challenges across domains and platforms. Ensure data is modeled for trusted consumption by business users, data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and application teams. Technical Leadership and Modeling Assurance Act as a senior technical authority for data modeling and architecture decisions across enterprise data initiatives. Mentor data modelers, data engineers, analysts, and delivery teams on modeling standards, patterns, review practices, and quality expectations. Lead model reviews, resolve design trade-offs, and guide teams on semantic consistency, reusability, performance, and maintainability. Document architecture decisions, model assumptions, standards exceptions, and reusable design guidance for enterprise adoption. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in data modeling and enterprise architecture. Outcomes of Success Successful performance in this role will be demonstrated by enterprise conceptual, logical, and physical data models that are standardized, scalable, reusable, and aligned with business domains. Canonical models, conformed dimensions, reference data structures, and naming standards will improve semantic consistency across domains. Curated layers and data product schemas will support trusted reporting, analytics, AI enablement, and downstream consumption. Metadata, lineage, data quality, stewardship, and governance expectations will be embedded into modeling and integration patterns. Delivery teams will receive strong modeling assurance, coaching, and practical design guidance, leading to reduced duplication and improved reuse.

d326c703d293aabb.description: JOB PURPOSE Key internal interfaces include the CEO, executive leadership team, healthcare asset leaders, quality and patient safety teams, clinical operations, digital health, legal and compliance, talent acquisition, and partnership teams. Key external interfaces include regulators, accreditation bodies, clinical partners, academic institutions, sports federations, professional teams, and other strategic healthcare partners. The Chief Medical Officer (CMO) is QHC’s most senior clinical executive and the single accountable owner of enterprise clinical strategy, medical governance, quality, patient and athlete safety, and clinical standards across all QHC healthcare assets. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the CMO brings clinical leadership, standards-setting, assurance, and medical advisory authority under one role, ensuring clear and consistent clinical accountability while operational delivery remains with the respective healthcare businesses and functions. The CMO ensures that clinical delivery across all QHC healthcare assets follows the QHC’s clinical and wellness standards, quality expectations, and readiness requirements, reflecting international evidence-based practice and applicable Saudi regulatory requirements. As a member of the QHC executive leadership team, the CMO translates the Kingdom's Vision 2030 and Qiddiya’s healthcare ambitions into governed, accountable practice, championing patient and athlete safety, clinical research and academic collaboration, and positioning QHC as a regionally recognized centre of clinical excellence. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES The role sets enterprise clinical standards, quality expectations, and governance requirements for all QHC healthcare assets, while day-to-day operational delivery, staffing deployment, and business-unit execution remain accountable to the relevant operating leaders. 1. Enterprise Clinical Strategy & Medical Affairs • Provide overall clinical leadership and set the enterprise clinical strategy for QHC across all current and future service lines, in alignment with the QIC and Vision 2030 healthcare transformation objectives. • Serve as the principal clinical voice on the executive leadership team, advising the CEO / MD and the Board and Medical Advisory Committee on clinical strategy, service development, clinical risk and medical policy. • Provide clinical and wellness input into service models and define the clinical standards, quality expectations and readiness requirements for all healthcare assets. • Represent QHC's clinical capabilities to sports federations, professional teams, government stakeholders, regulators and strategic partners. 2. Clinical Governance, Quality & Patient / Athlete Safety • Establish QHC’s overarching clinical governance and quality framework, setting expectations for patient and athlete safety, clinical quality, risk and compliance across all healthcare assets. • Provide a consistent enterprise-wide framework for clinical quality and accountability, ensuring clear standards and expectations across all healthcare assets. • Define, monitor, and report enterprise clinical KPIs and quality dashboards for clinical partnership or assets under direct operation of QHC. • Define clinical governance and escalation requirements, ensure appropriate review of priority quality, safety, and service issues, and provide senior clinical guidance on corrective actions, risk mitigation, and follow-up accountability. 3. Clinical Excellence, Protocols & Care Pathways • Set QHC’s enterprise clinical excellence, safety and wellness standards across all healthcare assets, aligned with evidence-based international practice and applicable Saudi regulatory requirements • Provide clinical and wellness guidance to all healthcare assets on service models, safety requirements and areas for clinical improvement • Develop and continuously review clinical policies, evidence-based care pathways, treatment protocols and standard operating procedures of clinical partners and QHC operated assets aligned with international best practice. • Promote evidence-based, person-centred models of care that integrate physical, psychological and social dimensions of health, wellbeing and performance, as relevant to the populations served. • Set enterprise clinical requirements for documentation, information governance, patient confidentiality and related clinical compliance, in line with applicable Saudi regulatory requirements and relevant international standards. 4. Sports Medicine & Citywide Healthcare Clinical Advisory • Provide clinical and wellness advisory support to all healthcare assets, providing input into service models, clinical readiness requirements, quality expectations and relevant performance measures. • Advise on multidisciplinary and integrated approaches to care, supporting alignment with QHC’s clinical standards and evidence-based practice. • Provide clinical guidance on priority service areas and readiness requirements, identifying clinical gaps, risks and opportunities for improvement. 5. Partnerships, Research & Academic Collaboration • Contribute to the development and implementation of clinical partnerships with institutions by supporting knowledge exchange, capability building, and the integration of leading practices into clinical care. • Support research, innovation, and academic collaboration initiatives, facilitating clinical engagement in research, education, and evidence-generation activities. • Participate in evaluating and adopting emerging clinical technologies, digital health solutions, and clinical analytics that enhance clinical practice and support data-driven decision-making. Role success will be measured by the design and deployment of all QHC healthcare assets, engagement of QHC clinical partnerships, achievement of clinical readiness milestones, compliance with applicable Saudi regulatory and accreditation requirements, adoption of approved clinical standards and care pathways, strength of clinical partner engagement, and sustained improvement in patient and athlete safety, quality and cost indicators through value based care. EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS Medical degree (MD, MBBS, MBChB, or equivalent) with board certification or postgraduate specialty qualification in a relevant discipline is required. Additional qualifications or experience in clinical leadership, sports medicine, population health or related fields are preferred Active registration and licensure with the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) at Consultant level, or clear eligibility for SCFHS Consultant classification, is required. Dataflow primary source verification and SCFHS Mumaris Plus registration must be completed prior to commencement. 15+ years of progressive clinical experience, with a substantial track record in senior clinical leadership, medical director or chief-level roles within accredited healthcare institutions. Experience delivering care to professional athletes, elite teams or comparable high-performance environments is highly desirable. Proven expertise in clinical governance, patient-safety management, multidisciplinary team leadership and quality improvement within a regulated healthcare environment. Prior experience in JCI and/or CBAHI accredited institutions and within partnership or joint-venture clinical models is highly preferred. Strong working knowledge of Saudi MOH and SCFHS licensing and regulatory frameworks, and of the clinical operating requirements of a startup or greenfield healthcare organization.
